Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)
Type: Cyberarm
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)
Option Slots: uses 2

Cyberarm Option, costing 2 Option Slots. The fist counts as an Excellent Quality Heavy Melee Weapon and rolls Brawling. Weapons needing BODY 11 or under stop penalizing this arm, and Melee Weapons in its hand are used as though the wielder had BODY 11. Buy a second and install both in a paired set of Cyberarms to extend that BODY 11 to prying doors open, shifting Thick Cover, Choking, and Slamming.

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo's Humanity Loss is 4d6 halved, rounding up. CPR can only roll a plain dice formula for humanity loss, so the rolled option is 2d6: same 2-12 range and same average of 7, a slightly flatter spread. Pick the static 7 at install if you'd rather not roll.
  • Cyberware items have no Quality field, so the Excellent Quality is in the text only.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
